pro_course_detail.title: 💯🎓 Accelerated Course (Intensive 10-Week Program with Homework) 🚀
pro_course_detail.description:
WHO SHOULD TAKE THIS COURSE? 

Dedicated, desperate, highly motivated students who MUST quickly improve their English for work, school, or an exam.

😉 Before getting a package, please schedule a single lesson of any kind so that we can decide if this is the right course for you.

Equivalent to 1 year of English study in a university (20 lessons for 10 weeks)
To choose this option, purchase 1 package of 20 lessons.

THIS COURSE INCLUDES:

•	A document summarizing the scientific research into effective language learning methods. I will go over it with you so that you will know exactly what to do to improve as quickly as possible. 
•	Homework assignments based on scientific research. 🔬 
•	Speaking/listening practice (description, free talk, topic based, work based, etc..), pronunciation practice, vocabulary growth, corrections. 
•	A Google Doc which includes new vocab, corrections, recommendations, & more. 
•	Spoken grammar practice (without the memorization of grammar rules or exercises). 

COMMITMENT REQUIRED

90-minutes/day, 5 days/week, for 10 weeks, including 1.5-2 hours of conversation classes a week with me. 

THREE MAJOR COMPONENTS

1. Conversation classes on Skype
You will have 2, 45 minute or 1-hour conversation classes a week with me. 

2. Daily homework outside of class
Three days a week you will do 90 minutes of homework. You’ll practice listening, reading, speaking, and sometimes a little writing. 

3. Homework report
At the beginning of each class, you will tell me about your homework to practice recalling what you learned, and to encourage you to continue practicing on your own. ;)

No Risk: Cancel at any time

If at some point you don’t feel like you can continue these lessons, you may cancel and receive a refund for classes not yet taken.

pro_course_detail.title: 📚 Read and Discuss Articles or Books Together💡
pro_course_detail.description:
Reading for pleasure is the fastest way to improve your grammar and vocabulary!

(😉 Before getting a package, please schedule a single lesson so we can see if we're a good fit.) 

I will evaluate your English level and help you select an interesting book or article to read together in class. :D

IMPROVE YOUR PRONUNCIATION: We will take turns reading out loud so you can listen to and practice correct English pronunciation. Pronunciation is extremely important!

INCREASE YOUR VOCABULARY RAPIDLY: I will explain the meaning of new vocabulary words, so we can read without long pauses to look up the words in a dictionary. You will learn new words much more quickly than by other methods because you are learning in the context of a story and because you will see the words repeated. Language research says you will learn new vocabulary 10 to 20 times faster by reading, than by using traditional methods.

IMPROVE YOUR GRAMMAR: The science of language learning tells us the best way to improve English grammar is to read extensively. As you do, your brain will unconsciously absorb grammar. This is much MORE FUN AND EFFECTIVE than studying grammar in textbooks.

GAIN CONVERSATIONAL CONFIDENCE: We will talk about what we read which can reduce the pressure of trying to figure out what to discuss. ;)
